hook: Two kinds of AI: one recognizes, one creates.

beats.say: Show a computer ten thousand cat photos and ask two questions: is this a cat, or can you draw a new one?
A discriminative model answers what is this, learning the probability of a label given an input, like a ninety-four percent chance that a digit is a seven.
A generative model learns what a new example could look like, and a GAN pits a generator against a discriminator to learn it.
